items.title: An Artin-Rees constant survives a flat base change of Noetherian rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is a base change statement for the Artin-Rees lemma: if c works for a map f of finite modules over a Noetherian ring A, then c works for the base changed map over a flat Noetherian A-algebra B with respect to the extended ideal IB (statement lines 283-290). The proof is an 18-line computation with preimages and kernels (proof lines 292-309): it writes the intersection of the image of the base changed map with I^n N tensor B as the image of the preimage under the base changed map, identifies that preimage with the tensor product of the preimage f^{-1}(I^n N) with B by using that B is flat over A, and then applies the hypothesis on c over A. The whole content is the middle step, since flatness is exactly what allows kernels to be computed before tensoring, and the author states that commutation in one sentence.
